title: Resolute Technique
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Resolute Technique}}

'''Resolute Technique''' (often referred to as '''RT''') is a [[keystone passive skill]] that will raise your chance to hit to 100%, ignoring all [[accuracy]] and [[evasion]] stats of the attacker and defender respectively, at the cost of preventing you from dealing [[critical strike]]s.

==Mechanics==
Because [[elemental damage]] will no longer critically strike, most elemental [[status ailments]] will not apply unless another source adds chance. Skills such as {{il|Glacial Hammer}} and {{il|Burning Arrow}} have a built-in chance to inflict elemental status ailments, and for example, targets cursed with {{il|Conductivity}} have a chance to be shocked when hit with any lightning damage.

Sources of guaranteed critical strikes, such as {{il|Trypanon}} and the Diamond [[Shrine]], have no effect on a character with the Resolute Technique.

[[Spell]]s inherently can't be evaded, so they don't benefit from Resolute Technique, but it still takes away their ability to crit.

Attack hits can still be [[block]]ed, even with Resolute Technique.

==Location==
Resolute Technique is located on the west edge of the tree, across the [[Disemboweling]] passive cluster.
